query:
insert into UsableRequirements (
                product_id,
                req_id
            )
            select product_id, id
            from Requirements r

            except

            select product_id, req_id
            from
            (
                select product_id, req_id
                from DeprecatedRequirements

                union all

                select product_id, req_id
                from (
                    select product_id, req_id
                    from ExcludedRequirements

                    union all

                    select product_id, req_id
                    from DraftRequirements
                )
            )
